description: Dodgers Digest's final 2019 signing table (2019-07-12), transcribed for the LAD 2019 class. Only the entry for a pick whose bonus no other source gives is imported (scripts/research/sources/draft-bonus-report-import.mjs); the rest are kept here as evidence and compared with Baseball-Reference in docs/evidence/lad-2018-2019-draft-certification.md.

source.title: 2019 MLB Draft signing update: Jimmy Lewis signs, Dodgers also land Allison
source.notes: Round / player / slot / bonus / savings table; total bonus $8,411,800 against the $8,069,100 pool. MLB.com (Jim Callis) reported the same Hoese figure, unconfirmed by the club.

import.note: Hoese: $2,740,300 (= slot), as MLB.com also reported; Baseball-Reference shows no bonus. Busch (#31) also signed at exactly slot in both this table and Baseball-Reference.

evidence_only.note: transposed digits in one of the sources; not decided
